# Mission backdrops and map art

Official VALORANT map splash artworks distributed by
[Valorant-API](https://valorant-api.com/v1/maps) (field `splash` of each map).
Downloaded on 2026-10-23, center-cropped/resized to 1920×1080 and saved as JPEG
quality 86. Only the 10 maps present in the hackathon base are kept:
abyss, ascent, breeze, fracture, haven, lotus, pearl, split, summit, sunset.
